clause_a.text: per cell, |eps_meas - eps_pred| <= 0.015 T0 with eps_pred = filter + rounding + S and nothing tuned; AND the sign of eps_meas differences between adjacent m=1 grid betas (0.10->0.13, 0.13->0.16) is reproduced by eps_pred

clause_b.text: within each committed m=1 plateau, eps_meas range across the ladder < 0.016 T0 (the committed force-scan drift bound), and between the ladder endpoints the slip term S moves in the same direction as eps_meas whenever |delta eps_meas| > 0.002 T0 (else the direction sub-clause is vacuous for that beta)

clause_c.protocol: onset frame = floor(t*fps); interval = frame difference of consecutive dominant-cluster onsets; doubling comparator = synthetic train at spacing 2 T0 from the same first onset, same quantization; overlap = nonempty intersection of the two supports
clause_c.text: cells on the no-overlap side show zero histogram overlap with the doubling comparator; cells on the overlap side show overlap
